Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so tell me why my son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of your class.
Don't thank me. Tell me why Owen learned about this from his phone, in front of his class, before anyone called me.
How do I wrap up this meeting?
You answer my question, and then I leave. Why did Owen find out about a zero from his phone, in class, before anyone called me?
